mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, conditions at Fireman's Park are clear and 44 degrees under a waning crescent moon. Tonight, the temperature will drop to a low of 38 degrees, and there is no rain in the forecast.

Public works will be performing pavement repairs on November 10 and 11, affecting Morningside Boulevard and Mozart Street, with no parking allowed from 7 AM to 7 PM. Additionally, the Plan Commission is reviewing new development projects for the Liberty Business Park at their December 7 meeting.

Today, you can visit the Dane County Farmer's Market or enjoy music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead, you can catch live music at the Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow, or check out yoga at Insight Wellness on November 9.
On October 25, officers arrested a 40-year-old man for an O W I first offence after finding him in his vehicle at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Really Reese's. Culver's is open right now and will be serving guests until 10:30 PM tonight, so stop in for a treat.
